newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific moving to Dallas.
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific moving to Dallas.

text.p: Union Pacific Corp said Tuesday it is relocating its downsized headquarters to Dallas, effective September 1.

"We couldn't have had two finer metropolitan areas from which to choose. Dallas and St. Louis are world-class cities with all the amenities, but in the end Dallas won the toss because of Union Pacific's overall presence in Texas," said chief executive Dick Davidson.

"Our 8,000 Texas employees represent the largest workforce we have in any of the 23 states where we operate and the largest financial impact with some $700 million in payroll, taxes paid and purchases."
Union Pacific has been in Bethlehem since 1988 following a move from New York, the company noted.

On March 18 Union Pacific announced a restructuring and relocation plan that would downsize the corporate headquarters to 45 from 120, with some of those not going to the new location taking jobs at Union Pacific Railroad offices in Omaha and the remaining receiving severance.
